name: Handful of Gems
description: Get 1,000 gems to unlock classes and goodies.

name: Pouch of Gems
description: Get 2,400 gems (2,000 + 400 bonus) to unlock classes and goodies.

name: Crate of Gems
description: Get 4,800 gems (3,600 + 1,200 bonus) to unlock classes and goodies. Most popular!

name: Truckload of Gems
description: Get 10,000 gems (7,000 + 3,000 bonus) to unlock classes and goodies. Best value!

name: Scare a Friend
description: Pick a friend in your crew and give them a spooky (and silly) jumpscare!

name: Anomaly Radar
description: Marks every anomaly around the stand for 90 seconds. Night only.

name: Hot Coffee
description: Restores your sanity at night. During the day you get a hot coffee in hand.

name: Wild Restock
description: Refills any ingredient you choose to the max.

name: Full Pantry
description: Refills all your ingredients to the max.

name: Revive Kit
description: Adds one extra revive so you can get a fainted crewmate back on their feet.

name: Tip Bag
description: Adds $60 to your crew's cash in this run (about one night of sales).

name: Coin Pile
description: Adds $150 to your crew's cash in this run (about two nights of sales).

name: Coin Chest
description: Adds $330 to your crew's cash in this run (about four nights of sales).

name: Night Kit
description: Hot coffee, the Anomaly Radar for 90 seconds and a Revive Kit, all at once. Night only.

name: Starter Crate
description: 2,400 gems and 2 Revive Kits to start your crew. Once per player.
